title: Vale Vision Frames Plus
alludes_to: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses (Gen 2) — camera glasses
description: The Vale Vision Frames Plus is a Signature-original vision frames in the smart glasses family. It tracks the working profile of Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses (Gen 2) — camera glasses: second generation with longer battery life and faster capture. Introduced in 2025, it serves everyday wearers.
